name: Can You Survive?
summary:
Can You Survive?
The Outbreak Has Arrived. The Question Is, How Long Will You Last?

The world as you knew it has collapsed. Civilization has crumbled under the weight of an relentless, rotting tide, and you are trapped in the eye of the storm. In Can You Survive?, there is no extraction, no cure, and no sanctuary—only the next wave.

The Endless Tide
